capabilities: Insert markup and blank lines with Alt keys
Jump between line starts and ends
Fill wikilinks and restore scroll on navigation
extras: Desktop-only; Alt+S, Alt-tap, Alt/Shift drags, and double-tap ,/. cannot be remapped; no settings tab, data file, or network access.
